notes: Both cited template locations were opened. Line 55 is confirmed verbatim and line 211 is confirmed verbatim, but they state generic naming/trait mechanics built from placeholders (spec.package, spec.short_name, md5sum) - neither names tf2_msgs/TFMessage; 'TFMessage' occurs nowhere in the u0105 snapshot (rg over the whole snapshot), and the assertion 'type name taken from the input spec tf2_msgs/TFMessage' is a statement about how the generator was invoked, not a location. Also 'struct @(spec.short_name)_' is at line 94, not the cited 95 (line 95 is '{'). definition_id: the command hashes TFMessage.msg plus dependency definitions fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com URLs; none of these files exist in the snapshot, and network use is out of scope. The one accurate mechanism cite (msg.h.template:211 embeds the genmsg-supplied md5sum as the MD5Sum trait) states no hash value, so the recorded md5 cannot be checked.
